title: Rules: inheritance, interface, and implementation conventions
objective: Constrain extending, implementing, assignability, and sealed-hierarchy relationships.
acceptance_criteria: Direct and transitive relationships are explicit.
Unknown external ancestors cannot silently pass strict rules.
Violations show the relevant hierarchy path or permitted-subclass evidence.
non_goals: Do not weaken protected contracts, workflow configuration, or unrelated capabilities.
Do not load or execute target classes, builds, plugins, annotation processors, or code.
Do not copy implementation code from the upstream ArchUnit project.
Do not add dependencies or change Maven configuration.
